children: SAID ON TUESDAY IT HAS ADOPTED UPDATED ARRANGEMENT PROPOSALS IN SANATION PROCEEDINGS
UPDATED PROPOSALS INTRODUCE CONDITIONAL ADDITIONAL SATISFACTION MECHANISM FOR CREDITORS
CREDITORS IN GROUPS II, V, AND VI WILL NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE ADDITIONAL SATISFACTION

IN DETERMINING THE AMOUNT OF THE ADDITIONAL SATISFACTION, 50% OF THE FUNDS ACTUALLY RECEIVED BY THE COMPANY PURSUANT TO THE COAL DECISION - NET OF TAXES, MANDATORY PUBLIC LEVIES, AND DIRECT COSTS OF PURSUING THE CLAIM OR OBTAINING SATISFACTION - WILL BE TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PRINCIPLES SET OUT IN THE ARRANGEMENT PROPOSALS
PROPOSALS TO BE SUBMITTED TO COURT AND CREDITORS' COUNCIL FOR OPINION
